repositories.name: MinerU (OpenDataLab PDF-Extract-Kit)
repositories.primary_metric: Deep learning PDF extraction suite converting formulas to KaTeX, complex tables to HTML/Markdown, and figures to images
repositories.production_tradeoff: Requires PyTorch GPU runtime (8GB+ VRAM) or slower multi-threaded CPU fallback for high-throughput batch extraction

repositories.name: Docling (IBM Research Document Parser)
repositories.primary_metric: Enterprise document parser for RAG pipelines with TableFormer layout analysis and native DoclingDocument JSON/Markdown output
repositories.production_tradeoff: Model weights download (~2GB) on cold start; CPU inference takes 1.5s per complex page without ONNX acceleration

repositories.name: Unstructured (Open-Source ETL for LLMs)
repositories.primary_metric: Modular document ingestion engine supporting 25+ formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, XML) with partition_pdf strategy='hi_res'
repositories.production_tradeoff: Heavy system dependencies (tesseract, poppler, detectron2) requiring dedicated Docker base images

repositories.name: Marker (Surya OCR PDF-to-Markdown)
repositories.primary_metric: Ultra-fast PDF-to-Markdown extraction using Surya layout detection, math recognition, and text extraction with table heuristics
repositories.production_tradeoff: Commercial use requires dual licensing or compliance with GPL-3.0 copyleft requirements

repositories.name: NLM-Ingestor (LLMSherpa Layout Engine)
repositories.primary_metric: Layout-aware document chunking engine preserving tables and nested section hierarchies for vector RAG retrieval
repositories.production_tradeoff: Java backend dependency requiring JVM container sidecar or Docker orchestration
